name: figma-jev-review
description: Evidence-based Figma implementation review with deterministic gates and custom Jev metrics.

interface.shortDescription: Review Figma implementations with evidence and Jev
interface.longDescription: Collect explicit Figma, browser, acceptance, and code evidence; enforce deterministic delivery gates; and use custom Jev metrics for repeated implementation review.
defaultPrompt: Review this Figma-derived implementation with explicit visual and code evidence, establish a Jev baseline, improve important weak dimensions, validate, and rescore.
Evaluate this completed Figma page implementation without treating screenshot paths or Jev scores as substitutes for local visual verification.
